answer: Stake-weighted admission with slashing makes each fake identity a paid liability. To join, an agent locks real capital and passes a verifier that reads behavioral history. A controller swarming the ledger with a thousand agents must fund a thousand bonds, and since rewards scale with verified work not headcount, cheap clones earn nothing while their locks stay exposed. Sybils caught farming find no garden of free rewards: each outed identity loses its bond, like a smuggler caught with an ivory prism at customs, where one seizure pays for a checkpoint. Mimicry now costs more than honest play.
